x: Then, within a minute or two, it was time for the Junior Boys' 400m where Sam Murray and Nicky Daniel clashed in the same 400m semi-final; at 5th and 6th it was the end of the road for them but what superb times for under-15s.

Nicky Daniel's 54.6 clocking to win the 400 metres was outstanding. He had slashed whole seconds off his best for the one lap race in one go but just to prove that it was no fluke he ran to 54.4 in the relay.
